# Build with Jeremy

> Jeremy Pittman is a Strategic Ops Partner and Fractional COO consultant helping established service businesses ($500K–$5M revenue) scale without chaos. 12 years at Google in operations, programs, and product launches. Top Rated on Upwork with 100% Job Success Score.

## About

Jeremy Pittman helps service businesses remove operational bottlenecks so they can scale without adding headcount or chaos. The core approach: Diagnose the bottleneck → Design the system → Deploy automations and tools → Discipline with documentation and training. He has built 20+ custom systems for 30+ businesses and consistently doubled admin output for clients.

Background: 12 years at Google (ops, logistics, product launches at scale). Now full-time consultant working with home services, logistics, staffing, and agency businesses.

## Services

- [Strategic Ops Partner (Retainer)](https://buildwithjeremy.com/services/) — Fractional COO support for $500K–$5M service businesses. Ongoing partnership: operating cadence, automations, dashboards, documentation, and training. Best for teams where operations are the bottleneck.

- [2-Week Systems Sprint](https://buildwithjeremy.com/services/) — Fast engagement: diagnose the bottleneck, ship 1–2 high-leverage fixes, deliver a 60–90 day roadmap. For smaller teams or a "try before retainer" start.

- [AI Audit & Team Training](https://buildwithjeremy.com/services/) — Practical AI adoption: identify where AI can save time this quarter, train the team, implement 1–2 automations. No hype, no theory — just what works now.

- [AI Employee Setup](https://buildwithjeremy.com/ai-employee/) — Done-for-you AI assistant configured on a Mac Mini with your tools, brand voice, and workflows. Shipped to your door ready to work 24/7. Specialized setups for agencies.

- [Operations Consulting](https://buildwithjeremy.com/operations-consulting/) — Find the constraint capping the business, rebuild the systems around it, train the team to run them. Diagnose, Design, Deploy, Discipline. For service businesses of 5-25 people.

- [AI & Business Automation Consulting](https://buildwithjeremy.com/ai-automation-consulting/) — Deciding what is actually worth automating, then building it. A task qualifies when it happens weekly, follows rules you could write down, and depends on someone remembering it. Includes saying no when automation is not the answer.

## What is a strategic operations partner?

A strategic operations partner is a senior operator who works inside your business part-time to fix how it runs — the handoffs, the systems, the reporting, the things that quietly break when you grow. Unlike a consultant who delivers a report and leaves, a partner stays to build and run what they recommend. Think of it as a fractional COO who also does the implementation.

Businesses typically need one past $500K in revenue, when the owner has become the bottleneck: everything routes through them, growth makes things worse rather than better, and the number the business is managed by lives in a hand-updated spreadsheet.

- [Full explanation](https://buildwithjeremy.com/strategic-operations-partner/) — including how the role differs from a management consultant and from an operations manager, and when each is the right hire.
